target: Derive a formal or quantitative account of curriculum learning using an ordered-versus-shuffled training trial. Meet a declared latency and fail-safe limit under concurrent load.

competency.title: Derive curriculum learning — real time
competency.outcome: Derive a formal or quantitative account of curriculum learning using an ordered-versus-shuffled training trial. Meet a declared latency and fail-safe limit under concurrent load.

topic_kernel.failure_to_detect: claiming curriculum gain without equal compute

competency.practice_task: Produce a stepwise derivation with units or invariants grounded in an ordered-versus-shuffled training trial.
competency.setting_constraint: Meet a declared latency and fail-safe limit under concurrent load.
required_evidence: a stepwise derivation with units or invariants
Include p95 latency, timeout behavior and rollback trace.
Report learning-curve area and old-task retention with uncertainty or an explicit deterministic check.
Construct a negative control for the failure mode: claiming curriculum gain without equal compute.

assessment.scoring: Each criterion: 0 absent, 1 partial, 2 demonstrated; require 2 on all four.
assessment.threshold_policy: Register the metric threshold, baseline, task budget and evaluator before exposing new items.
criteria: Concept: correctly state the assumptions and limits of curriculum learning.
Practice: the derivation reproduces a checked special case.
Measurement: report learning-curve area and old-task retention against a matched baseline with reproducible inputs.
Critical check: test for claiming curriculum gain without equal compute; detect it or rule it out with evidence.

competency.source_policy: Reviewer must add a verified primary source before lesson status; no source is fabricated here.
competency.contamination_policy: No private items, answers, seeds or reviewer-only prompts in this public specification.
